name: Waldorf Astoria Dubai Palm Jumeirah
positioning: Beach resort with a private beach on Palm Jumeirah, with a club lounge, a kids club and a wide spread of restaurants and bars
best_for: Families who want a supervised kids club and a private beach
Travelers who want club-lounge access with a suite or Pearl Club room

facts.text: The hotel is on Palm Jumeirah and has a private beach.
Recreational activities include tennis, fishing and parasailing.
Rooms and suites are done in a beach palette of ivory, sand and soft turquoise, with European-style furnishings and bespoke lighting.
The Pearl Club lounge is on the fifth floor.
Pearl Club access comes with a Pearl Club room, a Pearl Club suite, a Waldorf Astoria suite, the Chairman's Suite or the Royal Suite.
Social serves a modern take on peninsular Italian cuisine.
YU serves contemporary Chinese cuisine drawing on Cantonese, Sichuan and Beijing traditions.
Palm Avenue serves California comfort food by the pool.
Mezzerie serves international buffets, with themed dinners every night.
Serafina Bar serves cocktails and small bites, with premium spirits and cigars.
The spa has 12 treatment rooms and two private couples suites.
Coco's Kids Club offers supervised activities for children aged four to twelve.

highlights.text: The Pearl Club lounge pays homage to the UAE's pearl-diving heritage.
Peacock Alley brings the heritage of New York's famous tea lounge to Dubai, with a classic Afternoon Tea.
Sunset 55 is a beach lounge inspired by the bohemian spirit of the 1950s.
Conde Nast Traveler describes dinner in a two-person cabana that seems to float above the pool.
A Personal Concierge escorts guests to their room on arrival and handles details such as Pillow Menu choices and priority restaurant bookings.

considerations.text: Social, the Italian restaurant, welcomes guests six and older.
The Pearl Club has a smart casual dress code.
